description: Co-founder dispatches an approved budget raise on Brand Search (the only way this workflow runs — it is never self-initiated); google-ads-agent claims, reads API creds from the vault, applies the budget mutation via the API, verifies pacing with a follow-up read, and confirms back on the ticket with result + digest.

inputs.change: Raise daily budget from $120 to $160 (approved BUD-114)

dispatch.title: Apply approved budget raise BUD-114 — Brand Search to $160/day

args.title: Apply approved budget raise BUD-114 — Brand Search to $160/day

args.note: GAQL: read back budget + today's pacing to verify the change took

args.comment: BUD-114 applied: Brand Search now $160/day, API read-back confirms. Pacing nominal — 41% of budget spent at 11:00 PT.

args.result: Approved budget raise BUD-114 applied: Brand Search daily budget $120 -> $160. Read-back verified; pacing nominal at 41% spent by 11:00 PT. Change logged to the daily log; will watch impression share lift over the next 3 sweeps.
args.digest: Applied google.scale_budget (BUD-114, Brand Search to $160/day) and verified pacing. Next wake: confirm impression share climbs off the 71% lost-IS-budget floor.
